help.title: EvPortal Guide — Tesla Browser, Shortcuts & Backups
help.description: Open EvPortal in your Tesla browser, organise your favourites and transfer backups by code, link or QR. Learn how to get started and restore your shortcuts.
help.heading: EvPortal guide for the Tesla browser
help.intro: Tap a shortcut to open the service in a new tab. Dark mode is the default; your chosen light or dark theme is then saved. The eight languages are available in Settings with their native names and flags; Arabic is displayed from right to left.
help.ranking: All shows your most frequently opened shortcuts first. Ties keep your manual order. The ranking is saved after reloading.
help.dragging: In a category or Favorites, tap Edit and move shortcuts using their handles. The star adds a favorite and the pencil lets you edit. Tap Done when finished. All keeps its automatic ranking.
help.keyboard: With a keyboard, focus a handle, press Space, move with the arrow keys, then confirm with Enter. Escape cancels.
help.adding: The “+” button opens the same catalogue for everyone. Expand or collapse a category, then use Add or Remove on a service. Create a shortcut and Create a category are at the top of the catalogue. The magnifying glass searches all your shortcuts.
help.categories: Create up to five personal categories with names of up to 16 characters and an icon of your choice. More icons opens the additional choices. Use the pencil to edit a category. Older categories exceeding these limits are kept. Visible categories fit without horizontal scrolling.
help.stepPrepare: In Settings → Backups → Phone, choose Send or Receive.
help.stepPublish: Scan the displayed QR code with your phone.
help.stepCode: To send from your phone, choose its shortcuts or a backup, then tap Send.
help.stepImport: On the receiving screen, tap Add to keep the backup on that device.
help.stepApply: To use its contents, open My backups → Restore.
help.qr: QR codes are for phone transfers. Creating a code or link does not display a QR code.
help.snapshot: The transfer is encrypted and valid for five minutes when the service is available. It sends a snapshot without automatic synchronization. Receiving a backup does not replace your shortcuts.
help.public: In Settings → Backups → Code or link, Create prepares a code and an EvPortal link to copy. Add accepts either and saves a local copy after validation. JSON files remain available under More options. The created Telegra.ph page is public; the local copy and online page are separate.
help.fullscreen: While parked, tap Fullscreen. On YouTube, choose Go to site to return to EvPortal in Theater mode. Shortcuts request a new tab; its behavior depends on the vehicle browser.
help.fullscreenFallback: If the Tesla is not recognized, choose Open Tesla Theater in settings. On a computer, the button uses regular fullscreen. The redirect may change with vehicle or YouTube updates.
help.compatibility: Opening a site does not guarantee video playback: country, account, subscription, and browser restrictions may apply. Use entertainment while parked.
help.storage: In Settings → Backups → My backups → Restore, choose a backup under On this device or Online, then check its contents. Only Restore replaces your shortcuts. More options in Settings lets you undo the last restore. Adding a code, link, file, or QR transfer saves a backup without applying it. Each browser keeps its own local list.
help.preview: The QR uses the address of the open portal. On a phone, localhost or 127.0.0.1 refers to the phone itself. For testing across devices, both must be able to reach the portal and relay over HTTPS. Backup codes and links use the public EvPortal address.
help.privacy: EvPortal is free and is not affiliated with Tesla. Logos and translations are bundled with the site. Opening counts stay in your configuration, with no analytics service. Telegra.ph is contacted at your request; the account token stays separate from the share. Sites you open apply their own policies.
help.preferences: In Settings → Home, choose which categories to show and whether to open on your favourites. These preferences stay on this device and are not included in backups or QR transfers. Manage the catalogue using the “+” button.
help.sharedServices: A service can appear in several categories with one favorite status and one counter; All shows it only once. In Edit, open Other categories to choose where it appears. Deleting a category keeps services that also belong to another category.
help.appearance: In Settings → Appearance, keep the Standard size or choose Small. Show names lets you keep the names below the logos or hide them. Standard size and visible names are the defaults; your choices stay on this device.
